content.comment_body: Received a technical question from [user_name] via private message. I have the latest version of [product_name] V8.3.1, but the device appears as an unknown device. What should I do? Could this be because I'm using Windows 11?

If you start a new network project and click the 'Go Online' button, [product_name] will scan for all reachable devices. If device names are not assigned, they will show up as 'Unknown'. This is not a real issue.
That wasn't the main problem—I couldn't download anything to the device. After switching to Windows 10, it works fine!
I didn't mention that you couldn't download anything. Please review your initial question and my reply.

Apologies for not wording my question clearly. The main problem was that it didn't work on Windows 11. When trying to interact with it, V8.3.1 showed an error stating that a newer software version is needed. You're correct that the device still appears as 'Unknown', even on Windows 10, but at least it's usable now. I appreciate your quick response—this is my first project with [product_name], so thanks for the help. I know where to look next.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion focuses on compatibility challenges between [product_name] V8.3.1 and Windows 11, resulting in the device being recognized as 'Unknown' and preventing downloads. Switching to Windows 10 resolves the issue, although the device continues to show as 'Unknown' while remaining functional. The conversation highlights concerns about software compatibility with newer operating systems and suggests that clearer error notifications regarding software versions would benefit users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to consistently detect and communicate with related hardware on Windows 11, and to offer clear and informative error messages whenever issues arise.
